theorem reference_uniform_gaussian_bounds {lam u : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam) (hu : 0 < u) :
    ∃ c C : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∀ ell : ℝ, 0 < ell → ∀ time ∈ Icc 0 ell,
      Real.exp (-C * (time - ell / 2) ^ 2 / ell) ≤
          envelope (referenceRate lam u ell) (ell / 2) time ∧
        envelope (referenceRate lam u ell) (ell / 2) time ≤
          Real.exp (-c * (time - ell / 2) ^ 2 / ell)
